content: In-memory rate limiting (Map keyed by IP/fingerprint storing count+resetTime, pruned periodically) is a practical zero-dependency option for single-instance/low-traffic Next.js Server Actions/API routes; documented limitation: state does not persist across serverless cold starts or multiple concurrent instances on Vercel, so it is a best-effort throttle, not a hard guarantee — acceptable as one layer alongside honeypot + Turnstile for a low-traffic B2B site, with migration path to Upstash Redis if traffic grows.
